component_requirements.description: The cycle-control software component shall run a sterilization cycle (idle → running → complete or fault), evaluate chamber peak temperature against 121°C ± 2°C, and accept a cycle only when total duration is ≤ 60 minutes.
component_requirements.title: Cycle engine

component_requirements.description: The door-safety software component shall inhibit cycle start when the door is open and require the door to remain locked while cycle state is running.
component_requirements.title: Door safety

component_requirements.description: The UI software component shall expose English status and alert strings for each cycle state (idle, running, complete, fault) and door-locked conditions.
component_requirements.title: Operator UI

design_outputs.description:
Sterilisator 20A cycle-control SaMD for a tabletop steam sterilizer: software evaluates sterilization cycle temperature and duration, enforces door interlock while running, and presents English operator status (idle, running, complete, fault). Not a hardware catalog entry.

Implementation in src/sterilisator_20a/ (cycle/controller.py, safety/door.py, ui/messages.py). CodeLinks markers: # @need-ids: DOUT_018.
design_outputs.title: Sterilizer 20A

system_requirements.description: Device shall achieve and maintain sterilization temperature of 121°C ± 2°C.
system_requirements.title: Sterilization temperature range

system_requirements.description: Total cycle time shall not exceed 60 minutes.
system_requirements.title: Sterilization cycle time

system_requirements.description: A sterilization cycle shall not start unless the chamber door is closed. The door shall remain locked while the cycle is running.
system_requirements.justification: Prevents operator exposure and incomplete sterilization from door opening during an active cycle.
system_requirements.title: Door interlock

system_requirements.description: The user interface shall display cycle state and alerts in English, covering idle, running, complete, fault, and door-locked conditions.
system_requirements.justification: Compliance with MDR user-information expectations; clinic staff must read status without translation.
system_requirements.title: English cycle status

unit_requirements.description: temperature_within_range shall return true if and only if peak chamber temperature is in [119.0, 123.0] °C.
unit_requirements.title: Peak temperature window

unit_requirements.description: reported_cycle_duration_minutes shall reject negative durations; cycle_within_time_budget shall return true if and only if reported duration is ≤ 60 minutes.
unit_requirements.title: Cycle duration acceptance

unit_requirements.description: After start_cycle returns, cycle state shall be complete when temperature and duration both pass, otherwise fault. The returned result shall not leave the cycle in running.
unit_requirements.title: Cycle states

unit_requirements.description: Cycle start with door open shall be refused. door_must_lock shall be true if and only if cycle state is running. door_may_open shall be true for idle, complete, and fault.
unit_requirements.title: Door start-inhibit and lock

unit_requirements.description: English UI payload shall cover idle, running, complete, and fault states plus a door-locked alert; non-English language or empty required strings shall fail the English-label check.
unit_requirements.title: English state labels

user_requirements.description: The operator shall be able to steam-sterilize reusable instruments so that heat-resistant microorganisms are inactivated during intended use, without unloading while the chamber is in an unsafe (in-progress) state.
user_requirements.title: Safe and effective instrument sterilization

user_requirements.description: Clinic staff shall finish a sterilization cycle within a treatment-room timebox and understand cycle status and alerts in English.
user_requirements.title: Operable in a clinic workflow

validations.description: Ten consecutive intended-use sterilization cycles with independent temperature logging and observed door behaviour.
validations.title: Intended-use sterilization

validations.description: Ten consecutive full cycles timed end-to-end; operators identify cycle states from the English UI using normal and fault scripts.
validations.title: Clinic operability
